item.title: Jumma ki Sunnatein | Friday Sunnah Reminder in Urdu
item.description: جمعہ کے فضائل و آداب: غسل، ناخن کاٹنا، خوشبو، سورۃ الکہف اور کثرت سے درود۔ Jumma Mubarak, Friday Sunnah reminder in Urdu.

item.title: Friday Sunnah Checklist: Ghusl, Perfume, Surah Al-Kahf & Durood | Jumu'ah Reminder
item.description: The Sunnah acts of Jumu'ah (Friday) from authentic hadith: ghusl, cutting nails, perfume, clean clothes, going early, Surah Al-Kahf and abundant durood. Friday reminder.
